results.text: CheckPropertyAction should check at least one property of a TestItem
CreateStimulusAction must provide AT LEAST ONE stimulus to a TestItem
ExpectResponseAction should receive at least one response from a TestItem
CheckPropertyAction owner of Constraint: If applied on a Constraint, the owner of this Constraint must only be a State (referring to the Constraint as StateInvariant) or StateInvariant.
CheckPropertyAction owner of checkedProperty: If 'checkedProperty' is not empty, the referenced Property must belong to a TestItem participating in the current test-specific procedure.

CreateStimulusAction forbidden elements types: The tag definition 'forbiddenElement' shall only contain instances of the following metaclasses: Message, Event, Signal, BehavioralFeature, Trigger, InstanceSpecification.

CreateStimulusAction permitted elements types: The tag definition 'permittedElement' shall only contain instances of the following metaclasses: Message, Event, Signal, BehavioralFeature, Trigger, InstanceSpecification.

ExpectResponseAction explicit sets types: The tag definitions 'forbiddenElement', 'expectedElement' and 'ignoredElement' shall only contain instances of the following metaclasses: Message, Event, Signal, BehavioralFeature, Trigger, InstanceSpecification.

ExpectResponseAction enforced expectationkind: In the cases, when «ExpectResponseAction» is applied to a Message in the context of an Interaction, and the Message's signature is left empty, or when «ExpectResponseAction» is applied to a Trigger that yields an AnyReceiveEvent, the 'expectationKind' of the «ExpectResponseAction» shall be set to 'implicitExpect'.
SuggestVerdictAction type of Input Argument: The type of the argument InputPin must be the predefined verdict type or a subtype thereof.
Each TestCase returns a Verdict statement: Any Behavior stereotyped as «TestCase» returns a ValueSpecification typed by verdict after arbitration had happened.

DataType in DataSpecification

Clients of Morphing Dependency: As clients of a Dependency stereotyped with a concrete substereotype of «Morphing» only the following elements are allowed: Constraint with «DataSpecification» applied.
DataProvider must have a DataSpecification for providing data: This is done through a refines relationship or the dataprovider owns the dataspecification. See UTP spec section 7.4.1 and 8.6.1.2.5

Suppliers of Morphing Dependency: As suppliers of a Dependency stereotyped with a concrete sub-stereotype of «Morphing» only the following elements are allowed: Constraint with «DataSpecification» applied, UML Classifier, and UML Package.
Restriction of Overrides client and supplier: As client and supplier of the underlying Dependency, only InstanceSpecification are allowed.
Cyclic Overrides NOT Allowed: Cyclic override is not allowed. A cyclic override means that an overridden InstanceSpecification transitively overrides its overriding InstanceSpecification.
